notes.text: Lists, player names and archetype names copied from mtgtop8, which took them from the organizer's (Card Titan's) Melee page; the lists were not compared card for card against Melee.

Placings and seeds are from the organizer's Melee page: seeds are the standings after the last Swiss round, and placings follow its playoff matches (quarterfinals: Hans Jacob Goddik def. Michael O'Malley 2-0; Brian Pallas def. Lee Webb 2-0; Peter Coloyan def. Kiet Ngo 2-0; Rajah James def. Stu Somers 2-0. Semifinals: Hans Jacob Goddik def. Brian Pallas 2-0; Rajah James def. Peter Coloyan 2-0. Final: Rajah James def. Hans Jacob Goddik 2-0). mtgtop8, which the lists were copied from, orders the Top 8 roughly by Swiss standing and had Hans Jacob Goddik 1, Kiet Ngo 2, Rajah James 3-4, Peter Coloyan 5-8; corrected here.
Swiss was played on 2022-12-09; mtgtop8 dates the event to that day. The Top 8 was played on 2022-12-11.
